is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii collected from vegetable farms in Yaoundé, Cameroon (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports genotyping of kdr L995F, L995S, kdr N1570Y, and Ace-1 G280S (Page 4, Table 1; Page 14, Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides sample sizes (n) and exact genotype counts (SS, RwS, RwRw, RwRe, SR, RR) and allele frequencies for kdr L995F/S, kdr N1570Y, and Ace-1 G280S across An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii populations from Nkolondom, Nkolbisson, and Ekié (Page 4 and 5, Table 1).

african_field_population.evidence: Field-collected larvae and pupae sampled from Nkolondom, Nkolbisson, and Ekié in Yaoundé, Cameroon, reared to adults in the insectary (Page 12, Section 4.2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper reporting original entomological collections, WHO susceptibility bioassays, and molecular genotyping assays.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific farming sites in Yaoundé, Cameroon with coordinates: Nkolondom (3°57'18" N, 11°29'36" E), Nkolbisson (3°52'46" N, 11°25'55" E), and Ekié (3°49'38" N, 11°31'53" E) (Page 11, Section 4.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Genotyped specimens were collected in April 2018 (overall survey conducted between April 2018 and October 2019) (Page 4, Table 1; Page 12, Section 4.2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Collections were conducted as part of the DMC-MALVEC project, but represent new routine cross-sectional survey data for Yaoundé.

supplement.evidence: All species identifications, bioassay summaries, and resistance marker genotype counts are fully reported in the main text and tables (Table 1 and Table 4).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated pyrethroid and pseudo-pyrethroid (etofenprox) resistance frequency and intensity across three agricultural sites in Yaoundé, Cameroon (Nkolondom, Nkolbisson, and Ekié) between 2018 and 2019. Subsets of control mosquitoes from April 2018 (n=50 per site, total 150 field mosquitoes) were genotyped for Vgsc L995F, L995S, N1570Y, and Ace-1 G280S, with full genotype counts and allele frequencies reported in Table 1.
